sloka: सप्तधा तु फलेन्मूर्धा मुनौ तपसि तिष्ठति ।ज्ञानाद्विसृजतः शस्त्रम् तादृशे ब्रह्मचारिणि ॥२-६४-२५॥
transliteration: saptadhā tu phalenmūrdhā munau tapasi tiṣṭhati ।jñānādvisṛjataḥ śastram tādṛśe brahmacāriṇi ॥2-64-25॥

translations.english: 'If any one deliberately discharges a weapon upon an ascetic observing austerities or on him who expounds the Vedas, his head will split into seven pieces.
